### 🟡 Changes recommended The new async test in tests/unit/backend/test_target_service.py needs an `_async` suffix to comply with the required naming convention.
1 open issue - [Add the required _async suffix to the test name](https://github.com/microsoft/PyRIT/pull/3777#discussion_r4481996922) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #3712 by identifying `TextTarget` as credential-free in registry metadata and displaying that information in the target-creation dialog. **Changes:** - Declare that `TextTarget` supports no authentication modes. - Show “No authentication required” for empty mode lists from loaded registry metadata, while preserving fallback behavior. - Add registry, backend, and frontend regression tests. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​unit/​registry/​test_target_registry.py` | Verify credential-free metadata and retain API-key-only coverage. | | `tests/​unit/​backend/​test_target_service.py` | Verify the API returns no authentication modes for `TextTarget`. | | `pyrit/​prompt_target/​text_target.py` | Declare an empty supported authentication-mode tuple. | | `frontend/​src/​components/​Config/​CreateTargetDialog.tsx` | Display credential-free status when registry metadata is available. | | `frontend/​src/​components/​Config/​CreateTargetDialog.test.tsx` | Add `TextTarget` coverage and verify the authentication description. |
Review effort: Balanced
Had to change this substantially since the original goal didn't make too much sense in the greater scheme of things...

review_comments.body: Please give this new async test an `_async` suffix to follow the required async-function naming convention, as the adjacent new-style tests do.
